| Category = Chicken recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (12–16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly-ground coriander
* 2 medium untreated maple planks, soaked in water at least 1 hour

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle both sides liberally with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and the freshly-ground coriander.
#Place chicken on planks and insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into one of the breasts. Heat one burner or push all the coals to one side and place planks on the cooler side. Cook until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
#Remove chicken to a plate and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

== Warnings ==
Use untreated wood. I don't think any of you would like to be eating pentachloraethylne, creosote, and/or arsenic! If you would not like to eat this stuff, remember to purchase untreated wood that is furniture grade and kiln-dried.
